result.title: SecretAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy Protection against Vision Language Models
result.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer private information from shared images, including locations, personally identifiable information (PII), and personal attributes such as age and sex, even from medical images. Adversarial perturbations can protect such information against black-box VLMs, but existing methods overlook image quality and introduce visible artifacts into the images they protect. We present SecretAgent, the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against VLMs while preserving visual fidelity. LLM agents iteratively locate the visual evidence that reveals private information and adapt an invisible perturbation to the target VLM's answers and to an appearance reviewer agent, which rejects any candidate with visible artifacts. We instantiate SecretAgent with two complementary variants: SecretAgent-Gradient optimizes the perturbation through six surrogate encoders for cross-model transferability, and the gradient-free SecretAgent-Tool composes procedural noise and achieves the best perceptual fidelity on three of the five datasets. Experiments on four privacy applications (geolocation, PII, facial, and medical) across five datasets and six VLMs show that SecretAgent preserves image quality substantially better than existing methods while achieving state-of-the-art privacy protection in every application, and that its protection transfers to other VLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SecretAgent 多智能体框架，用 LLM 智能体迭代定位图像中泄露隐私的视觉证据，并配合外观审查智能体生成不可见的对抗扰动，以在保持图像质量的同时阻止 VLM 推断位置、PII、面部与医疗属性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「迭代定位视觉证据并据反馈调整扰动」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容贡献分配提供核查线索，但论文目标是隐私攻击而非推理机制，需进一步判断可迁移性。
